name: Audio description
description: Finds films and series in Jellyfin that have a described sound track for blind and partially sighted people, and tags them. Plays it for people who choose it. Prefers releases with one.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Prefer releases with audio description
settings.hint: Reelix chooses with its own Audio description format: set it to Prefer in Settings, Reelix, Picture quality. While this is on, Check the Reelix choice now reminds you when Reelix does not prefer it.

settings.label: Add them to the Audio description collection
settings.hint: The films and series with a described track go into one Jellyfin collection, which every Jellyfin app shows. Off, the collection stays as it is.

settings.label: Jellyfin address for links
settings.hint: The address you open Jellyfin at in a browser, such as http://192.168.1.10:8096. Each title on Titles with audio description opens its page there. Left empty, Starboard's own address for Jellyfin is used when a browser can open it.

settings.label: Films to list
settings.hint: On Titles with audio description, the films most recently added to Jellyfin, newest first. Last 20 by default.

settings.label: Series to list
settings.hint: On Titles with audio description, the series with the most recently added described episodes, newest first, each with all its described episodes. Last 20 by default.

settings.label: AudioVault search links
settings.hint: A link to AudioVault's own search for each film and series without audio description. Starboard never downloads from AudioVault or reads its pages.

settings.label: YouDescribe search links
settings.hint: A link to YouDescribe's own search for each film and series, for described trailers and clips on YouTube. Nothing is fetched from YouDescribe.

settings.label: MovieReading and Earcatch
settings.hint: How to use these phone apps alongside Jellyfin, and where to get them. Neither publishes a list of titles, so Starboard cannot say which films they have.

jobs.label: Check for titles with audio description
Check the audio description choice in Reelix

changed: **Turn on and turn off:** the text and the help pages now say turn on and turn off. How it works has not changed.
Plainer wording in the text and help pages. How it works has not changed.

added: **Films to list and Series to list:** how many Titles with audio description lists of each: All, or the last 10, 20, 50, 100 or 500 added to Jellyfin, newest first. Last 20 by default. A series counts by its newest described episode and still lists all its described episodes.
**The page says how many it shows,** such as "Showing the last 20 of 143 films", and where to change it.
changed: **Newest first:** the films and series are listed by when they were added to Jellyfin, newest first. The nightly check keeps that date; select **Check for described titles now** once after updating.

added: **Titles with audio description:** every film, and every described episode by series, with its year, its described track and its status in words. Films and Series show their counts, and each title opens its page in Jellyfin. The same page as in Jellyfin's own Audio description plug-in.
**Jellyfin address for links:** the address you open Jellyfin at, for the links on Titles with audio description, when Starboard reaches Jellyfin at an address a browser cannot open.
changed: **The nightly check keeps a little more:** each title's Jellyfin id and year, and which episodes are described, for the page. Select **Check for described titles now** once after updating to fill it.
fixed: **Films in the collection:** the nightly check asks Jellyfin for each film, not the Audio description collection in their place, so once the collection was made, films in it no longer dropped out of the check and lost their tag.

added: **Find and tag:** each film and episode with a described sound track, and its series, gets the tag **Audio description** in Jellyfin at the nightly check, and the tag comes off when the track goes. Every Jellyfin app, televisions included, can filter by it.

**The Audio description collection:** turned on by default, the films and series with a described track are in one Jellyfin collection. Turn off **Add them to the Audio description collection** to leave it as it is.

**Play the described track:** for each person you turn on on its page, inactive until chosen. When they start a title with a described track and another plays, Starboard asks their app to change to it. Not every Jellyfin app accepts this.

**Rules 1.0:** the same rules file as Jellyfin's own Audio description plug-in. When that plug-in is installed, this one leaves the tag, the collection and Play the described track to it, and its card says **Idle**.
changed: **A new logo:** a film frame with a speech bubble holding a loudspeaker, to match the Jellyfin version.
**It hears when playback starts:** it asks to read what is playing (media:read), so Starboard tells it when someone starts a film.
**Check the Reelix choice now:** was **Apply the Reelix choice now**, and its job is **Check the audio description choice in Reelix**: both now only read Reelix and say what to do.
fixed: **Reelix (issue #144):** it no longer tries to add a format to Reelix or change its quality levels, which Reelix refuses to all but an admin key. It reads Reelix's own Audio description format and says to set it to Prefer in **Settings**, **Reelix**, **Picture quality**. The job no longer fails.

changed: **Clearer words:** **Look for described titles now** is now **Check for described titles now**, and its job is **Check for titles with audio description**. Its messages put the settings they name in quotation marks and spell out RNIB.
**Logo description:** where its logo stands on its own, a screen reader says "Audio description logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.

fixed: **Jellyfin 12:** it sends Jellyfin's key the way Jellyfin 12 asks for it, so Jellyfin no longer refuses its requests where legacy authorisation is off. Older Jellyfin still works.

changed: **Lighter at rest:** it wakes about once a minute while nothing asks it anything, not twice a second, and writes nothing to its folder when a run goes well.
**Starts faster:** its image comes with Python's modules already compiled, so a start takes about a quarter of the processor time.

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins, in the Catalogue and on its dashboard cards.
**Its cards say how things are:** a status and when they last changed, in the grey band at the top of each card.
**Updates safely:** before an update it finishes what it is doing and starts nothing new.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.1.0.

added: **AudioVault search links:** for each film and series without audio description, a link to AudioVault's own search. Turned off until you turn it on in Sources; Starboard never downloads from AudioVault
**YouDescribe search links:** for each film and series, a link to YouDescribe's own search, where volunteers describe YouTube videos such as trailers
**MovieReading and Earcatch:** how to use these phone apps alongside Jellyfin, which play a description in step by listening, and where to get them
changed: **Audio description elsewhere:** each place is now a link that opens in a new tab

added: Finds the films and series in Jellyfin with a described sound track, once a night in quiet hours
Prefers releases with audio description in Reelix
People who want audio description: Jellyfin remembers the sound track each of them chooses
Audio description elsewhere, and two dashboard cards
